title: Award level from the 2026–2027 Ministry admissions table type (owner decision)
notes: Owner decision of 13 November 2026. For a city-grouped 2026–2027 Ministry row whose university and teaching city an approved source already establishes, a row in the public faculty tables of announcements 2 and 4 (catalogue kind faculty) is a first university degree, recorded at the bachelor level, and a row in a technical institute table (kind institute) for an institute that the university runs is a technical institute diploma. sourceRecordId names the table type: faculty-table or university-institute-table. It does not cover labels for open learning, parallel, virtual or postgraduate study, diplomas listed in a faculty table, rows whose label names another city, institutes run by another ministry, or any row with two plausible faculties or universities.
